review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The exact minimax characterization and attainment are proved only for compact iid-Gaussian local neighborhoods; over the full stationary mixing class the note proves a uniformly root-n projection band and a one-sided local lower bound, but no matching globally honest attaining procedure. The TL;DR's claim to compute the exact local value is defensible only in the computable-limit sense: each finite LP supplies an approximation, and the note reports no nontrivial multidimensional numerical computation beyond the binary hinge calculation. Practical significance is also limited by the block-stable fixed-rank model and the absence of a worked synthetic-control application or computational performance evidence for the exponentially large acceptance-subset programs. These restrictions keep the package below flagship and below the strongest leading-journal benchmark, but they do not negate the delivered field-level local minimax theorem. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: transfer-kernel-not-discharged@thm:panel-experiment-transfer, related_work_incomplete@thm:certified-gaussian-value, positioning_missing@thm:panel-experiment-transfer
